arxiv-2103-16014.creator: Hua-sheng XIE, Richard Denton, Jin-song Zhao, Wen Liu
arxiv-2103-16014.description: Abstract Besides the relation between the wave vector 𝒌 \bm{k} and the complex frequency ω \omega , wave polarization is useful for characterizing the properties of a plasma wave. The polarization of the electromagnetic fields, δ ​ 𝑬 \delta\bm{E} and δ ​ 𝑩 \delta\bm{B} , have been widely used in plasma physics research.

arxiv-2109-07678.title: Effects of ϕ \phi -meson on properties of hyperon stars in density dependent relativistic mean field model
arxiv-2109-07678.creator: Zhong-Hao Tu, Shan-Gui Zhou
arxiv-2109-07678.description: Abstract The effects of ϕ \phi -meson on properties of hyperon stars are studied systematically in the framework of the density dependent relativistic mean field (DDRMF) model. The ϕ \phi -meson shifts hyperon threshold to a higher density and reduces the hyperon fractions in neutron star cores.

arxiv-2207-13487.description: Abstract . Correctness and robustness are essential for logic synthesis applications, but they are often only tested with a limited set of benchmarks. Moreover, when the application fails on a large benchmark, the debugging process may be tedious and time-consuming.

arxiv-2308-14435.title: Do Successful Researchers Reach the Self-Organized Critical Point?
arxiv-2308-14435.creator: Asim Ghosh, Bikas K. Chakrabarti
arxiv-2308-14435.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Asim Ghosh, Bikas K. Chakrabarti. The index of success of the researchers is now mostly measured using the Hirsch index ( h h ). Our recent precise demonstration, that statistically h ∼ N c ∼ N p h\sim\sqrt{N_{c}}\sim\sqrt{N_{p}} , where N p N_{p} and N c N_{c} denote respectively the total number of publications and total citations for the researcher, suggests that average number of citations per paper ( N c / N p N_{c}/N_{p} ), and hence h h , are statistical numbers

arxiv-2311-09145.title: Model Agnostic Explainable Selective Regression via Uncertainty Estimation
arxiv-2311-09145.creator: Andrea Pugnana, Carlos Mougan, Dan Saattrup Nielsen
arxiv-2311-09145.description: Abstract With the wide adoption of machine learning techniques, requirements have evolved beyond sheer high performance, often requiring models to be trustworthy. A common approach to increase the trustworthiness of such systems is to allow them to refrain from predicting. Such a framework is known as selective prediction.

arxiv-2404-14362.title: Bistable Organic Electrochemical Transistors: Enthalpy vs. Entropy
arxiv-2404-14362.creator: Lukas M. Bongartz, Richard Kantelberg, Tommy Meier, Raik Hoffmann, Christian Matthus, Anton Weissbach, Matteo Cucchi, Hans Kleemann, Karl Leo
arxiv-2404-14362.description: Abstract Organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) underpin a range of emerging technologies, from bioelectronics to neuromorphic computing, owing to their unique coupling of electronic and ionic charge carriers. In this context, various OECT systems exhibit significant hysteresis in their transfer curve, which is frequently leveraged to achieve non-volatility. Meanwhile, a general understanding of its physical origin is missing.

arxiv-2503-24011.title: Simulations in Statistical Workflows
arxiv-2503-24011.creator: Paul-Christian Bürkner, Marvin Schmitt, Stefan T. Radev
arxiv-2503-24011.description: Abstract Simulations play important and diverse roles in statistical workflows, for example, in model specification, checking, validation, and even directly in model inference. Over the past decades, the application areas and overall potential of simulations in statistical workflows have expanded significantly, driven by the development of new simulation-based algorithms and exponentially increasing computational resources.

arxiv-2505-03982.title: A residual-iteration framework for alternating projections between affine subspaces
arxiv-2505-03982.creator: Nguyen T. Thao
arxiv-2505-03982.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nguyen T. Thao. We reformulate the problem of alternating projections between two affine subspaces of a Hilbert space as the minimization of a least-squares functional associated with a bounded linear operator. This viewpoint reveals that classical alternating projections coincide with the unit-step Landweber iteration and enables the introduction of a general residual-state iteration framework that encompasses Landweber, its steepest-descent variant, and the conjugate-gradient method.

arxiv-2601-11212.title: Experimental study of coupled quantum billiards with integrable and chaotic classical dynamics and test of a special Rosenzweig-Porter model
arxiv-2601-11212.creator: Xiaodong Zhang, Jiongning Che, Barbara Dietz
arxiv-2601-11212.description: Abstract We report on the experimental study of the spectral properties of quantum systems consisting of two quantum billiards ( QB s), one with chaotic, the other one with integrable classical dynamics, that are coupled to each other via an opening in a common wall.

arxiv-2602-11840.title: Improved Universal Graphs for Trees An extended abstract that contains parts of this work was published in EuroComb’25 [ 2 ] .
arxiv-2602-11840.creator: Julian Becker, Konstantinos Panagiotou, Matija Pasch
arxiv-2602-11840.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Julian Becker, Konstantinos Panagiotou, Matija Pasch. A graph G G is universal for a class of graphs 𝒞 \cal C , if, up to isomorphism, G G contains every graph in 𝒞 \cal C as a subgraph. In 1978, Chung and Graham asked for the minimal number s ⁡ ( n ) s(n) of edges in a graph with n n vertices that is universal for all trees with n n vertices.

britannica-1911-stow-john.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-stow-john.description: Article 'Stow, John' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was the son of Thomas Stow, a tailor, and was born about 1525 in London, in the parish of St Michael, Cornhill. His parents were poor, for his father's whole rent for his house and garden was only 6s. a year, and Stow himself in his youth fetched every morning the milk for the family from a farm belonging to the nunnery of the Minories.

pmc-10660042.title: A high-efficient antibacterial and biocompatible polyurethane film with Ag@rGO nanostructures prepared by microwave-assisted method: Physicochemical and dermal wound healing evaluation
pmc-10660042.creator: Abbas Mohammadi, Zahra Ghorbanian Kerdabadi, Seyed Ahmad Ayati Najafabadi, Alireza Pourali, Fereshteh Nejaddehbashi, Nastaran Azarbarz, Kaveh Hatami Kahkesh, Mehrnoosh Ebrahimibagha
pmc-10660042.description: Wound infections are a significant issue that can hinder the wound healing process. One way to address this problem is by enhancing the antibacterial activity of wound dressings. Accordingly, this work focuses on developing a castor-oil-based antibacterial polyurethane nanocomposite film impregnated with silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) decorated on the surface of reduced graphene oxide (rGO) nanostructures (Ag@rGO).

pmc-11378878.title: Variation in nurses’ compliance with an Early Warning Score protocol: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-11378878.creator: Jobbe PL Leenen, Chantal L Mondria
pmc-11378878.description: IntroductionEarly Warning Score (EWS) protocols are based on intermittent vital sign measurements, and aim to detect clinical deterioration in a timely manner. Despite its predictive value, its effectiveness remains suboptimal. An important limitation appears to be poor compliance with the EWS protocol and its variation between general wards.

pmc-11495456.title: The Recurrence Rate of Colorectal Polyps among Patients with Average Risk of Colorectal Cancer
pmc-11495456.creator: Masoudreza Sohrabi, Mobin Obeidinia, Majid Reza Adelani, Parvin Hassanzadeh, Arya Shirani, Roya Pirniakan, Farhan Abbasi, Mahtab Sami, Amir Hasan Babaki, Hossein Ajdarkosh, Farhad Zamani
pmc-11495456.description: Background:CRC is going to be an important issue in Middle East countries. Also, the main parts of this cancer develop from benign adenomas. pmc-11541973.title: The Association Between Constipation and Positron Emission Tomography and Blood-Based Biomarkers in Older Cognitively Unimpaired Adults with Higher Amyloid-β Burden
pmc-11541973.creator: Heling Chu, Chuyi Huang, Fang Xie, Qihao Guo
pmc-11541973.description: IntroductionConstipation may be linked to cognitive decline and a higher risk of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). We aimed to investigate the association between constipation and positron emission tomography (PET) and blood-based AD biomarkers in older cognitively unimpaired (CU) adults with higher Aβ burden.

pmc-12565701.title: Anatomical and Functional Outcomes of Sutureless Scleral-Fixated Carlevale Intraocular Lens Implantation: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12565701.creator: Adam Słoka, Tomasz Chorągiewicz, Karolina Urbańska, Piotr Więsyk, Marcin Woźniak, Joanna Dolar-Szczasny, Mariusz Spyra, Katarzyna Nowomiejska, Mario Damiano Toro, Robert Rejdak
pmc-12565701.description: Background/Objectives: The purpose of this study was evaluation of the efficacy and the rate of complication of a foldable sutureless scleral-fixated intraocular lens (SSF-IOL), named Carlevale IOL, for the treatment of aphakia without sufficient capsular support due to trauma or complicated cataract surgery. Methods: Retrospective, consecutive interventional case series. All consecutive eyes with secondary implantation of aphakic SSF-IOL were considered.

pmc-12618245.creator: Josh Hashemi, Aleksi Räsänen, Tarmo Virtanen, Sari Juutinen, Guido Grosse, Mika Aurela, Annett Bartsch, Laura Chasmer, Scott J Davidson, Mika Korkiakoski, McKenzie A Kuhn, Mark J Lara, Miska Luoto, Pekka Niittynen, David Olefeldt, Oliver Sonnentag, Anna-Maria Virkkala, Carolina Voigt, Claire C Treat

We assessed how land cover map resolution and thematic detail influence these estimates. Using very high spatial resolution land cover maps (≤2.

pmc-12787268.title: Effect of Print Orientation on the Tribological Behavior of a Steel Powder-Modified Thermoplastic
pmc-12787268.creator: Krystyna Radoń-Kobus, Paweł Szczygieł
pmc-12787268.description: This article presents the results of research on a composite filament made of a thermoplastic polymer with the addition of steel powder, used to produce samples using Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) 3D printing technology. Samples were printed with different print orientations (0° and 90°) to assess the effect of print direction on mechanical and tribological properties.

pmc-13538250.title: Overcoming the oral delivery challenges of venetoclax: advancing a clinically improved Bcl-2 inhibitor
pmc-13538250.creator: Yukta Hegishte, Paul Joyce, Clive Prestidge, Kristen Bremmell
pmc-13538250.description: AbstractThe Bcl-2 inhibitor, Venetoclax, is a notable example of a therapeutic emerging from modern drug development pipelines with structural and physiochemical properties sitting beyond Lipinski’s “Rule of 5”. The classification of VTX as a biopharmaceutical classification system (BCS) Class IV compound aligns with its observed low solubility and permeability in the gastrointestinal tract.

pmc-13623699.title: Inflammasome expression patterns during bone regeneration: predictive biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets in non-union formation
pmc-13623699.creator: Maximilian M. Menger, Oguzhan Nakisli, Benedikt J. Braun, Steven C. Herath, Daniel A.K. Schäfer, Dominik Saul, Michael D. Menger, Emmanuel Ampofo, Selina Wrublewsky, Matthias W. Laschke, Tina Histing
pmc-13623699.description: BackgroundNon-union formation is one of the major complications in trauma and orthopedic surgery. The inflammatory response at the fracture site is crucial for determining the healing outcome. However, there is limited information on the expression profiles of inflammasomes during both successful fracture repair and non-union formation.
